import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate total spending across product categories
spending_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('Mnt')]
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_columns].sum(axis=1)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Marital_Status', y='Total_Spending', data=df)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.title('Total Customer Spending by Marital Status')
plt.xlabel('Marital Status')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending (€)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
